description: Atlas passes its local type, lint, test, production-build, and critical-route smoke checks after concrete defects are repaired.
steps: Install the locked dependencies without modifying the lockfile
Run TypeScript project checks and ESLint
Run the automated test suite
Build the production frontend and server bundles
Exercise critical public routes and verify that emitted assets load

description: The configured MiniMax mainland-China image-generation API accepts an environment-only credential and produces a valid image artifact.
steps: Confirm the supported domestic endpoint and model against current official documentation
Submit one minimal low-cost image request without logging or persisting the credential
Validate the provider response and download the generated artifact
Verify the image format, dimensions, content, and non-empty hash
Record only redacted request metadata and evidence

description: The configured MiniMax mainland-China video-generation API accepts an environment-only credential and completes a bounded short-video task.
steps: Confirm the supported domestic task, polling, and download contract against current official documentation
Submit one minimal low-cost video task without logging or persisting the credential
Poll with bounded retries until the provider reports a terminal state
Download and verify the video container, codec, duration, frames, and non-empty hash
Record only redacted task metadata and evidence

description: The publishable source, Git commit, production assets, and documentation contain no supplied API key, local credential, or unrelated repository metadata.
steps: Keep provider credentials in process environment only
Scan source and generated assets for key and token patterns
Exclude local environment files, provider artifacts, caches, and existing Git metadata
Inspect the exact staged tree before committing
Repeat secret scans against the committed tree

description: A clean GitHub repository named Atlas-Website hosts the verified Atlas frontend on GitHub Pages with working assets and client-side routes.
steps: Verify the requested repository name is available under the authenticated account
Create a clean repository without using the broken unrelated local Git metadata
Commit and push only the verified source and release configuration
Configure GitHub Pages and wait for its deployment workflow to complete
Fetch the public URL and verify the home page, assets, and a direct client-side route
